paragraphs: Mentioned in Chullin 66a and [Menachot 79b](https://www.sefaria.org/Menachot.79b.6): “Matityah ben Yehudah recited a teaching.”[^1]
Yuchasin records that he was Shmuel's student, but Hyman observes that no source is given there for this.

notes.text: Hyman gives Chullin 66a. The named teaching appears at [Chullin 67a](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.67a.7), which reads Matityah bar Yehudah. Menachot reads ben Yehudah. Hyman attributes the claim that Matityah studied under Shmuel to Yuchasin and observes that it supplies no source.
